name: Computer Science Plus (BS)
source: https://catalog.calvin.edu/ (2026-27 catalog, Computer Science Plus, BS, CS.MAJ)
sourceDescription: Calvin Academic Catalog 2026-27 program requirements for Computer Science Plus, BS, and the CS-Plus program page at https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/computer-science-plus.

requirements.label: Introduction to computing
requirements.note: The catalog lists CS 108 (preferred) or CS 106. The CS-Plus program page also notes that CS 104 can work with advisor approval.

requirements.label: External practicum or senior project
requirements.note: The catalog requires one of CS 383 (External Practicum), or CS 396 together with CS 398 (Senior Project in Computing I and II). A matching record is shown for review; verify the pair is complete.

requirements.label: CS 195
requirements.note: The catalog requires CS 195 for 3 semesters. Three distinct completed academic periods are marked complete; this does not verify the exact terms.

requirements.label: CS 295
requirements.note: The catalog requires CS 295 for 3 semesters. Three distinct completed academic periods are marked complete; this does not verify the exact terms.

courseGroups.label: Computer Science electives
courseGroups.subject: CS

courses.title: Embedded Systems and the Internet of Things
Computer Architecture and Digital Systems Design

courseGroups.note: Take 6 hours from the CS and ENGR electives listed in the Computer Science Plus program in the 2026-27 catalog. Saved Course Search exports supply current offerings; verify elective eligibility with your advisor.

manualRequirements.label: Plus Domain Study
manualRequirements.note: An additional 12 hours of study from the same department (or forming a cohesive body of study, with departmental approval), at least 2 hours of which must be at the 300 level. This depends on your chosen domain and is not checked automatically.

manualRequirements.label: Overall degree and core requirements
manualRequirements.note: This page checks listed course records only. It does not evaluate total degree hours, core requirements, or the official program audit.
